# PanePilot v0.4.0

PanePilot 0.4 expands file sharing, document review, speech, navigation, and exact
agent-session recovery across the desktop and Android companion source.

## Highlights

- Attach an independent rclone Google Drive account and folder to each project, then
  upload the authoritative saved local or SSH file from the Files workspace.
- Explicitly create and copy an anyone-with-the-link URL after a Drive upload, and
  revoke that public link from the same toolbar. Uploading alone remains private.
- Read terminal, chat, note, file, history, and manuscript content aloud with Google
  Neural2 voices, concise or verbatim reading, and a client-side monthly usage limit.
- Preview LaTeX PDFs inside PanePilot, print every page, and reveal local source and
  PDF files in Finder.
- Navigate the focused project with discoverable KeyTips and direct tab shortcuts;
  swap split panes without losing focus.
- Sort projects independently within each machine, show pane membership on split
  project glyphs, choose a custom Unicode icon, and drag terminal tabs into a saved
  client-local order.
- Force reload any Codex or Claude chat in place, including a failed or not-yet-linked
  launch, while resuming its exact provider session whenever one is known.
- Restore PanePilot-owned local tmux sessions after reboot, resolve the user's login
  PATH for agent launches, reduce terminal-output writes, and improve clipboard paste.
- Update PanePilot Remote source to 0.1.1 with optional Android Keystore-backed SSH
  password storage and compatibility with escaped tmux field delimiters.

## Download

The attached DMG and ZIP support Apple silicon Macs running macOS 12 or newer.
`SHA256SUMS.txt` contains SHA-256 checksums for both downloads.

PanePilot Remote for Android is currently provided as source under `android/`; this
release does not include a signed Android APK.

Stable latest-release link: [github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest](https://github.com/Salazar-Prime/PanePilot/releases/latest)

## First-launch note

This desktop build is not signed with an Apple Developer ID or notarized. After
copying PanePilot to Applications, Control-click it in Finder, choose **Open**, and
confirm the launch. Download PanePilot artifacts only from this GitHub repository.

Public Drive links are created only when **Create public link** is selected. Anyone
with that URL can open the shared file until **Stop sharing** removes public access.
